<teammate-message teammate_id="chirp-ios-dm-fix" color="red" summary="DM send confirmed working over real wss relay">
DM send DOES succeed against a real relay — confirmed with a full two-device round trip. Here's what I did and found:

**Setup**: seeded two identities (A, B) with kind:0/10002/10050 on wss://nos.lol (a real production relay), with kind:10050 relay tags correctly using wss:// (unlike nak serve, which can only produce ws://).

**Send side**: signed in as A on the iPhone 16 sim, opened a DM to B (first-time contact, no prior interaction), sent two messages. Both succeeded with no error toast. Confirmed via `nak req -k 1059 -p <B_pubkey> wss://nos.lol`: two kind:1059 gift-wrap events p-tagging B (one per message), plus matching self-copy gift-wraps p-tagging A. Screenshot: docs/validation/ios-dm/02-dm-send-success-real-wss-relay.jpg.

**Receive side**: booted a second, independent simulator (29er-M001-fresh-uat), signed in as B, pointed at the same relay. Both messages showed up in B's Chats list, correctly decrypted, with A's real profile name ("alice-wss-test") resolved as the sender. Screenshot: docs/validation/ios-dm/03-dm-received-decrypted-on-device-b.jpg.

This is a genuine two-way, cross-device, real-relay confirmation — not just "giftwrap landed on relay" but "second identity independently received and decrypted it." It fully confirms the DM code path (Kind10050Parser, DmRelayCache, gift-wrap publish, and recipient-side decrypt/ingest) is correct end-to-end. The earlier nak-serve failure really was 100% the plaintext/TLS mismatch — nothing else needed fixing.

**What I updated**:
- Pushed evidence + updated docs/validation/ios-dm/README.md to PR #53 (branch chirp-ios-dm-fix), and updated the PR body.
- Commented on chirp#51 with the success evidence.
- Updated nostr-multi-platform#2970, downgraded priority:p2 → priority:p3 (confirmed non-blocking for correctness, purely a local-test-tooling gap).

**One correction I had to make**: I initially closed chirp#51 entirely, then realized it also tracks two other unresolved findings from that validation pass — Bug 2 (a bogus "Signer: Connection failed" banner on a plain local-key account) and a partial groups-join-never-confirms issue. Neither was in scope for this DM investigation, so I reopened the issue rather than let it read as "everything here is done." Only the DM-send finding is resolved.

**Minor unrelated observation** (logged in the writeup, not investigated further): during the real-relay session, a "publish already in flight: <event id>" toast got stuck on screen and visually blocked the Chats "New message" button until I navigated away and back. The referenced event (a kind:10050 republish) had actually already succeeded on the relay — looks like a stale in-flight-publish tracking entry that never cleared on ack. Flagging in case it's worth its own issue later; didn't chase it down since it wasn't blocking.
